notes.purpose: jaxfne/experimental_hpc/ is a frozen "contracts" package that documents future/planned architecture (a v0.3.28+ tensor-first refactor, and a v0.4.0 physical PDE field solver) without implementing it. It is organized as: (1) contracts.py — the bulk of the package, declaring dataclasses/functions for a future tensor-first HPC/JAX architecture (Config, RuntimeStatic, CircuitSpec, ProbeSpec, NodeIdentity, SelectorSpec, MechanismSpec, WeightInitSpec, ConnectionRuleSpec, Net/FlatNet/TrackingMaps, SignalTensor/Signals, Paradigm, ObjectiveOutputSpec/ObjectiveResult, Trainer/TrainingResult, plus free functions compile_connection_rules/construct_net/flatten_net/unflatten_net/simulate_flat_izhikevich/weld_config/get_signal); (2) physical_field_solver_v040.py — a single-concern placeholder for a future physical/PDE volume-conductor field solver (PhysicalFieldSolverSpec, solve_physical_field). Both files follow the same "fail loudly" pattern: `_tbi()`/`_tbi_v040()` raise `NotImplementedError(">TBI-not-ready")` / `NotImplementedError(">TBI-not-ready: v0.4 physical field solver")` for every not-yet-real method/entry point (contracts.py: 35 occurrences of `_tbi()` per file-level grep at jaxfne/experimental_hpc/contracts.py; physical_field_solver_v040.py lines 27-29 and 56/67).
